title: MAIGO: Mitigating Lost-in-Conversation with History-Cleaned On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2605.27186v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models often solve tasks from a fully specified prompt but degrade when the same requirements unfold over multiple turns, known as the lost-in-conversation (LiC) gap. We trace part of this degradation to self-contamination: intermediate assistant replies enter later context and carry early deviations forward. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose MAIGO, an on-policy self-distillation method that reduces this contamination using history-cleaned references from the model's own policy. For middle turns, MAIGO removes prior assistant replies while preserving the user-visible sharded prefix; for answer turns, it distills from paired full-view references conditioned on the completed user-side dialogue. A reliability weight downweights middle-turn samples that disagree with the clean reference. MAIGO requires no verifier rewards, state labels, or inference-time scaffolding. translated_title: MAIGO：通过历史清洗的在策略自蒸馏缓解对话迷失问题
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型通常能够根据完整指定的提示词完成任务，但当相同的需求在多轮对话中逐步展开时，其表现会下降，这被称为“对话迷失”差距。我们将这种性能退化部分归因于自我污染：中间的助手回复会进入后续上下文，并将早期的偏差延续下去。基于这一机制，我们提出了MAIGO，这是一种在策略自蒸馏方法，利用来自模型自身策略的历史清洗参考来减少这种污染。对于中间轮次，MAIGO会移除先前的助手回复，同时保留用户可见的分片前缀；对于答案轮次，它从以已完成的用户侧对话为条件的成对全视图参考中进行蒸馏。可靠性权重会降低与干净参考不一致的中间轮次样本的权重。MAIGO不需要验证器奖励、状态标签或推理时的额外脚手架。在具有确定性……的LiC配对视图协议下（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MAIGO通过历史清洗的在策略自蒸馏方法，消除多轮对话中中间助手回复引入的自我污染，从而缓解大语言模型的“对话迷失”问题，且无需验证器奖励、状态标签或推理时的额外机制。
en_tdlr: MAIGO mitigates the lost-in-conversation gap through history-cleaned on-policy self-distillation that removes self-contamination from intermediate assistant replies, requiring no verifier rewards, state labels, or inference-time scaffolding.
